description: This file defines the MafValue class, which encapsulates a measured value related to MAF (Mass Air Flow) sensor data. It provides methods for creating instances from integer values or parsing strings, as well as retrieving the value and string representation.

classes.name: MafValue
classes.description: A class representing a mass air flow sensor value, encapsulating an integer and providing utility methods.

methods.name: MafValue
methods.description: Constructor that initializes MafValue with a specific integer.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the stored maf value as an integer.

methods.name: valueOf
methods.description: Static method to create a MafValue instance from a string, using Utils.parseIntWithReason for parsing.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides Object's toString method to provide a string representation of MafValue.
